comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This weapon is part of the New Era of Weapons Memorial Album. It can be obtained by purchasing it from an item shop for 3,000 ducats in the following cities:

Portsmouth (England - Southern Britain Island)
Le Havre (France - Southern Britain Island)
Rotterdam (The Netherlands - North Sea)
Bilbao (Spain - Bay of Biscay)
Viana do Castelo (Portugal - Northeast Atlantic Ocean)
Cattaro (Venice - Adriatic Sea)
Manchester (neutral; Northern Britain Island)

Investment (amount unknown by me, apologies) is required to make the pistol appear; only Manchester allows all nations to invest and the rest are restricted to their nation's players.

wiki:
Part of New Era of Weapons Memorial Album.

How to get it: Item Shop - 3,000 Ducats*
(*180,000 ducat investment required before it can be purchased.)

Sold in the following cities:
Manchester
Bilbao (Spain territory)
Viana do Castelo (Portugal territory)
Cattaro (Venice territory)
Le Havre (France territory)
Rotterdam (Netherlands territory)
Portsmouth (England territory)

Note: Manchester is the only city open to all players for investment.
